headline: UMass Boston thrives on decisive finishes
dek: UMass Boston played only one draw all season, collecting eleven wins and six losses while scoring 40 goals and conceding 28. That attacking output alone exceeded the combined totals of Eastern Connecticut and Keene State, keeping the program in pursuit near the top of the league.
displaced_by: Western Connecticut's season totals updated to 13 wins and 51 goals, invalidating the standing dek.
